en: {fb:6580}{n}{spk:0080}{n}I get it, but would I make it in time if I went?{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}If I didn't make it in time, I wouldn't know what to do with myself... Sorry, but try someone else.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{fb:6F80}{n}{spk:0080}{n}I understand... But I'm sorry. I have my own affairs too.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}I hate to say it at a time like this, but my hands are full. Sorry, my dear angel. Could you ask someone else?{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{fb:7980}{n}{spk:0080}{n}I understand, Angel. It's a terrible thing, but...{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}It sounds like a scary place, and I don't know if I'm strong enough to save him right now... I'm sorry...{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}
{fb:2080}{n}{spk:0080}{n}Not a job I wanna get mixed up in, but I can't just leave it, can I?{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}If I'll do, I'll go. Leave it to me!{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{fb:3E80}{n}{spk:0080}{n}If a knight got caught, the enemy must be strong, huh? But I'll go! We can't just leave him like that!!{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}It's okay, Big Sis. I'll rescue him, you'll see!{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}
{fb:0180}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0080}{n}Understood... This time I'll save Reiv.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}
{fb:0380}{n}{spk:0080}{n}Still don't wanna get mixed up in it, but botchin' it and leavin' it at that don't sit right with me.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}I'm off.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}
{fb:0480}{n}{spk:0080}{n}Understood. I think I'll be all right this time. I'll be going... Angel.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}
{fb:0680}{n}{spk:0080}{n}Okay. This time I won't lose, no way! I'm going!!{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}
{fb:0780}{n}{spk:0080}{n}Got it. This time I'll save him, for sure... Okay, I'm off!{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}
{fb:0880}{n}{spk:0080}{n}Got it... I'll go. Don't worry, Angel. I won't mess up again.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}
{fb:0980}{n}{spk:0080}{n}Okay, I'll be fine this time. I won't goof up again. Well, I'm off!{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}
{fb:0A80}{n}{spk:0080}{n}Got it... I looked pretty lame last time, but this time I'm gonna save him for sure!{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}
{fb:0B80}{n}{spk:0080}{n}I can hardly refuse, can I? This time... I'll save him properly.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}
{fb:0C80}{n}{spk:0080}{n}It's a little scary... but I'll go. I think I'll be all right this time.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

Isn't that a hard choice to make?{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0180}{n}But I'm sure you can overcome anything, Angel.{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0180}{n}You're the angel who gave me courage, after all... I believe in you.{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0180}{n}Please come visit the castle someday. You'll always be welcome.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:E783}{n}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{fb:0180}{n}{e0:E0FF}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0180}{n}I'm so glad peace has returned to the world...{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0180}{n}You taught me so many things, Angel.{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0180}{n}And above all, thanks to you, I was able to find myself again.{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0180}{n}I'm truly grateful. I'm sure my brother is happy to see me as I am now.{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0180}{n}Goodbye, {name:0080}. Please take care of yourself. Thank you, truly, for everything.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:E783}{n}{e5:0080}{n}{end}
{spk:0080}{fa:0180}{n}From what the Angel said, it should be around here...{n}{wait}{clear}{end}
{spk:0080}{fa:0180}{n}I can't allow beings like you to exist. Prepare yourself!{n}{wait}{clear}{end}
{e0:050C}{spk:0080}{fa:0180}{n}This person is being controlled by the fallen angels too... No... To think I have to fight...{n}{wait}{clear}{end}
{e0:060C}{spk:0080}{fa:0180}{n}...... Fallen angels... I won't forgive them...{n}{wait}{clear}{end}
{e0:040C}{spk:0080}{fa:0180}{n}Yes, that's right.{n}{wait}{clear}{end}
{e0:080C}{spk:0080}{fa:0180}{n}Fallen angel Apollyon! Why do you fight?!{n}{wait}{clear}{end}
{e0:0A0C}{spk:0080}{fa:0180}{n}A fallen angel is here...?{n}{wait}{clear}{end}
{e0:0B0C}{spk:0080}{fa:0180}{n}That's right. I am the hero Juliana. I've come to defeat you.{n}{wait}{clear}{end}
{e0:0C0C}{spk:0080}{fa:0180}{n}Hideous demon, perish...{n}{wait}{clear}{end}
{e0:090C}{spk:0080}{fa:0180}{n}So there are still more fallen angels...{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:E783}{fa:0180}{n}Come, let's go on.{n}{wait}{clear}{end}
{spk:0080}{fa:0180}{n}Why do you fight?!{n}{wait}{clear}{end}

{spk:0080}{fa:0180}{n}Demon... so you've finally appeared.{n}{wait}{clear}{end}
{spk:0080}{fa:0180}{n}Wh-what?!{n}{wait}{clear}{end}

{e0:110C}{spk:0080}{fa:0180}{n}I won't let the hands of demons defile this world any longer!{n}{wait}{clear}{end}

{spk:0080}{fa:0180}{n}Angel, it seems there are still enemies behind us.{n}{wait}{clear}Please hurry and save her. I'll deal with the enemies.{n}{wait}{clear}{end}

{f7:0080}Some years have passed since I left.{n}{f7:0080}〔{n}{f7:0080}Gaap was defeated, time flowed again,{n}{f7:0080}and Infos found peace.{n}{f7:0080}〔{n}{f7:0080}The hero who did the most for that,{n}{f7:0080}Juliana, seems to live a quiet life.{n}{f7:0080}〔{n}{f7:0080}She returned to Andrang Castle, a place{n}{f7:0080}of painful memories, and seems to have{n}{f7:0080}resolved to protect her domain.{n}{f7:0080}〔{n}{f7:0080}Now her servants have returned, and as{n}{f7:0080}a lord with a kind and caring heart,{n}{f7:0080}she has earned her people's deep trust.{n}{f7:0080}〔{n}{f7:0080}She has opened most of her land to her{n}{f7:0080}people, and it seems she often goes{n}{f7:0080}out into the fields with them.{n}{f7:0080}〔{n}{f7:0080}And at the harvest festival, they say{n}{f7:0080}she invites everyone for a grand party.{n}{f7:0080}〔{n}{f7:0080}Overcoming so many hardships, and{n}{f7:0080}living as a hero, may be what{n}{f7:0080}changed her.{n}{f7:0080}〔{n}{f7:0080}No, perhaps she has simply{n}{f7:0080}become herself again......{n}{f7:0080}〔{n}{f7:0080}Seeing her laugh beneath the sun{n}{f7:0080}makes me very happy.{n}{f7:0080}〔{n}{f7:0080}I think fondly of the days{n}{f7:0080}I spent with the heroes.{n}{f7:0080}〔{n}{f7:0080}Together we overcame many hardships,{n}{f7:0080}and I was able to stay by their side{n}{f7:0080}and watch them grow.{n}{f7:0080}〔{n}{f7:0080}Infos holds precious memories of them.{n}{f7:0080}Watching over it is my joy now.{n}{f7:0080}〔{n}{f7:0080}To all who live in beautiful Infos,{n}{f7:0080}may blessings be upon you.{n}{f7:0080}〔{n}{end}
